|strategy=By [mailto:zube@eagle.cc.ukans.edu Nick Zube]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/chokk.html</ref>

It happens to the best of us. You're sitting at a site, draining away, minding your own business, when a swarm of EPP Mains plops down, blasts away your cannon fodder, and sticks your favorite mains with three destiny draws of attrition. Don't you just hate that?

So does [[Jabba]] the Hutt. That's why he hired [[Chokk]].

This versatile alien can save you from mains &#150; and their toys &#150; all by himself. While he's solid in battle, with a hefty 4 Power (and 4 Armor to make up for his low ability), what makes him an easy pick for any deck is his game text, a cornucopia of defensive goodies with something for everyone.

Alien-heavy decks will appreciate his defense value bonus to alien leaders, but anyone can appreciate his 7 power on the defensive and his blaster weapon destiny bonus. And, of course, there's his most significant ability: your characters present may not have their forfeit values reduced. That's right, those EPP scum can blast away all they want, but your forfeit fodder is safe as can be as long as [[Chokk]]'s around.

So, how to use this little bodyguard best? [[Chokk]] is great if you want to deploy fast for early Force drains, because he not only offers huge power when your opponent tries to shake you off, but he also supplies protection from weapons, which means you can spread out a little bit further in the meantime. He can also cement your control of a key location, like the Audience Chamber,

Or you can just give him a blaster and unleash him on an unsuspecting opponent.

What can I say? He takes pride in his work.

Combos:

The Dynamic Duo! 11 power on the defensive, and double the weapons protection for your characters.

The Terrific Trio! Two battle destiny, high defense values all around, tons of power, and a sacrificial lamb just in case things go bad.

From out of the Old West comes... "[[Chokk]], Gunslinger of Doom!" Back him up with the good doctor himself for high-accuracy destruction.
